prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Confirm the vehicle's basic details.
3. Verify the inspection date and location.
4. Include the inspector's identification.
5. Detail the type of test conducted.
6. Document the brake system configuration.
7. Record the testing conditions.
8. Note the pedal feel and response.
9. Log the stopping distance results.
10. Record deceleration measurements.
11. Note any observed brake fade.
12. Document brake noise assessment.
13. Assess brake pad and disc condition.
14. Check brake fluid levels and quality.
15. Inspect brake hoses for damage.
16. Examine calipers for leaks or damage.
17. Record ABS functionality status.
18. Assess anti-lock braking system response.
19. Note any ABS warning lights.
20. Evaluate parking brake effectiveness.
21. Document trailer
